name: Driving Simulator Tokyo
summary:
The dream drive, from the driver's seat - across Tokyo on the elevated Shuto Expressway, on the left, the Japanese way.

YOUR GARAGE
Start in a luxury three-car garage, a supercar either side of you. Touch the throttle and the door lifts onto your drive at Ariake, by Tokyo Bay.

THE CAR
A V12 sports car with a right-hand-drive race cockpit: racing wheel, roll cage, shift lights, a live display and a centre stack of real toggle switches. Steer with your hands or the joysticks.
